mapper.select: SELECT * FROM learning_sessions WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY started_at DESC
SELECT * FROM learning_sessions WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM learning_sessions WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_sessions (student_id, assignment_id, session_type, problem_ids, status, total_problems, solved_count, correct_count, started_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{assignmentId}, #{sessionType}, #{problemIds}, #{status}, #{totalProblems}, #{solvedCount}, #{correctCount}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_sessions SET status = #{status}, problem_ids = #{problemIds}, total_problems = #{totalProblems}, solved_count = #{solvedCount}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, completion_rate = #{completionRate}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, last_saved_at = #{lastSavedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE learning_sessions SET status = #{status} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_attempts (session_id, student_id, problem_id, submitted_answer, is_correct, time_spent_sec, is_bookmarked, requested_video, feedback_like, attempted_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{problemId}, #{submittedAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{timeSpentSec}, #{isBookmarked}, #{requestedVideo}, #{feedbackLike}, #{attemptedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM problem_attempts WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND problem_id = #{problemId} ORDER BY attempted_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM problem_attempts WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY attempted_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM problem_attempts WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND is_correct = #{isCorrect}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(login_date, '%m/%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM ( SELECT DATE(last_login_at) AS login_date FROM users WHERE last_login_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND is_active = 1 ) t GROUP BY login_date ORDER BY login_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE DATE(last_login_at) = CURDATE() AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE DATE(last_login_at) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE DATE(last_login_at) >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE DATE(last_login_at) >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE(last_login_at) < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM problem_attempts WHERE DATE(attempted_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM problem_attempts WHERE DATE(attempted_at) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(solved_date, '%m/%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM ( SELECT DATE(attempted_at) AS solved_date FROM problem_attempts WHERE attempted_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) t GROUP BY solved_date ORDER BY solved_date ASC
